notes.ok_please_close: Chunk 01 decision: never leave English 'OK' in a Vietnamese button; 'Được rồi, …' is the agreed form (as in ok_thanks)
notes.ob_show_me: 'Chỉ mình xem' reads first as 'only me' (chỉ = only), ambiguous on a small button; 'Cho mình xem' is the plain child's 'show me'
notes.date_at: Placeholder is a date + time (shortDateTime 'dd MMM-yy hh:mm a'); 'lúc' expects a clock time, 'vào' takes a date (fr/es also use the date preposition)
